rows.note: For the literal geological event, 地震 is the all-purpose Cantonese word.

example.english: That earthquake shook the whole house and knocked all the cups onto the floor.
example.traditional: 嗰次地震震到全屋啲杯都跌晒落地。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 dei6 zan3 zan3 dou3 cyun4 uk1 di1 bui1 dou1 dit3 saai3 lok6 dei6

rows.note: Use 大動盪 for a figurative period or event of severe social or political upheaval rather than ground shaking.

example.english: This political earthquake threw the whole society into chaos.
example.traditional: 呢場政治大動盪令成個社會陷入混亂。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 zing3 zi6 daai6 dung6 dong6 ling6 sing4 go3 se5 wui6 ham6 jap6 wan6 lyun6
